interpretation: Observational retrospective diagnosis only. No training, optimizer steps, audit replay, searches, games, target changes, or promotion. Classification authorizes no intervention.

source_update_vectors.application: float32 add_ for each registered parameter tensor; archived float64 delta slice cast to float32; disposable model copies

arithmetic.gradient_source: production legal-mask and policy cross-entropy; autograd gradients accumulated as float64 sums of float32 chunk gradients in ascending selected-exposure order
arithmetic.equal_input_weighting: mean over 1242 exact-input identities; within each identity mean over all its exposures, retaining multiplicity
arithmetic.dot: float64 flat-vector dot of gradient and archived delta
arithmetic.residual: signed D - s; includes nonlinear behavior and numerical effects
arithmetic.midpoint: theta + 0.5*d with float32 parameter addition; residual CE_mid - CE_pre - 0.5*s

classification.finite_step_residual_dominant: D>0 and R>=0.75*D under both weightings
classification.first_order_direction_dominant: D>0 and S>=0.75*D under both weightings
